name: Bun mam nem
summary: Bún mắm nêm is rice noodles dressed with mắm nêm, the rich fermented anchovy sauce with garlic, chili, and shrimp, so the soft noodles take up the sauce. It is its own bowl, not bún mắm.
origin: The central coast, around Da Nang and Hoi An.
howToEat: Toss the noodles through the sauce so they soak it up. Order it as bún mắm nêm, not as bún mắm, which is a different broth.
where: In Da Nang, Con Market, beside mì Quảng, bánh bèo, bánh nậm, bánh xèo, and nem lụi.
In Hoi An, from shoulder poles and small roadside shops.
seoTitle: Bun mam nem — noodles in fermented anchovy sauce
seoDescription: Bún mắm nêm is rice noodles in rich mắm nêm with garlic, chili, and shrimp. Where to eat it in Da Nang and Hoi An.
